{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning worked
print("First few cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders (999999.99)
qa_orders = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of QA orders:", qa_orders.sum())

# Drop QA orders if any
if qa_orders.sum() > 0:
    sales_clean = sales[~qa_orders].copy()
    print("QA orders removed.")
else:
    sales_clean = sales.copy()
    print("No QA orders found.")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded.sum())

# Drop refunded orders
sales_final = sales_clean[~refunded].copy()
print("Refunded orders removed.")

# Confirm final dataset size
print("Final number of rows:", len(sales_final))"}
